title: helm(private): values schema v2 + init-hook stabilizations for upgrade/rollback
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: private deployments have repeatedly hit upgrade/rollback edge cases during tenant upgrades where values schemas diverge and init hooks race with chart hooks. This PR standardizes the values schema (v2) for the 'private' Helm chart, tightens templating validation, and stabilizes the init-hook ordering to avoid partial upgrades that require manual intervention.

What this PR does: - Introduces charts/private/values.schema.json v2 with stricter types and defaults for networking (vpc/subnets), storage, and key management. - Adds templating guards and clearer helper functions to reduce template evaluation errors when optional fields are omitted. - Reworks charts/private/templates/init-job.yaml and init-hook annotations so the init job runs deterministically before post-upgrade hooks; converts a few init responsibilities into idempotent jobs to improve rollbacks. - Adds a lightweight upgrade/rollback test harness under helm/tests/upgrade-rollback.sh and a Helm test that simulates partial failure + rollback. - Updates README and Chart.yaml with upgrade notes and migration steps.

Compatibility and migration: v2 schema is backwards-compatible for the majority of customers; changes enforce explicit KMS and storage mappings that were previously inferred. The PR includes a migration note and a small script (helm/scripts/migrate-values.sh) to help automated migration for large installs. For customers using heavily customized values we recommend running the provided validation locally and in CI before performing cluster upgrades.

Release notes: "Stabilize private Helm chart upgrade/rollback: values schema v2, deterministic init hooks, and migration helpers."
commits: Add values.schema.json v2; update templates and helpers; rework init-job ordering; add upgrade/rollback test harness; docs and migration script; address reviewer feedback (templating guards and tests)
review_comments:
Liam: 'Please add unit tests for the templating helpers and confirm behavior when kms.key is omitted.'
Maya: 'Added templating guards and unit test stubs; default behavior is to fail fast on missing KMS only when kms.required=true.'
Sofia: 'Init job ordering looks better, but can we make the post-upgrade hook idempotent to tolerate retries?'
Maya: 'Converted post-upgrade tasks to be idempotent and added a retry-safe semaphore file; added an integration test that validates post-upgrade idempotency.'
Diego: 'CI flaked on e2e once - looks related to race in the init job image readiness. Please add a readiness probe timeout and re-run.'
Maya: 'Added backoff to the init job readiness checks and increased timeout; re-ran CI - all checks passed.'
ci_summary: Checks: helm-lint (pass), unit-tests (pass), integration-tests (pass), e2e (flaky -> rerun -> pass), security-scan (pass). One e2e run failed due to a timeout on init job readiness; fixed and re-ran. Total CI run time ~42m.
merge_commit: feat(helm/private): values schema v2 + init-hook stabilizations
release_notes:
- Private Helm chart: values schema v2
- Deterministic init hooks to avoid partial upgrades
- Templating guards and improved helper functions
- Upgrade/rollback test harness and migration script
- Notes: run helm/scripts/migrate-values.sh when upgrading from schema v1
notes_for_ops: Operators: before upgrading run helm template --validate against values.schema.json or run helm/scripts/migrate-values.sh. If you pin custom templates, validate the new helper names in _helpers.tpl. The init job now uses a readiness probe with a configurable timeout (values.init.probe.timeoutSeconds).
